changelogEn: Like Suno: uploading a song now brings the lyrics AND the style together — the style box fills itself from your song
Lyrics now come in Roman letters: Bengali songs in Banglish, Hindi songs in Roman Hindi, English songs in English
Auto-lyrics now survives slow connections — the song is shrunk before sending, and a dropped connection retries by itself
Fixed auto-lyrics: Google retired its old AI models — the app now uses Google's current models, so lyrics extraction works again with your saved key
Reference screen corrected: your songs are made on your own server
Now running on your own music server — the app connects to it automatically, no setup needed
New My Server status on the Create screen — green when your server is online, tap it to check again
Full songs now finish inside the app — the wait for a finished song was raised to 30 minutes
Auto-lyrics: you can now paste your free Gemini key right in the app — lyrics extraction starts immediately
Update check now waits longer on slow connections, so update prompts arrive reliably
Fixed black text that was hard to read — all screen text is now white and clear
Duet voice moved to its own line — its label no longer wraps or breaks
Now powered by Rony's own server
Background darkened with a stronger dark layer — text is now clear and easy to read
App is now fully in English — all Bengali text removed
New background image — glowing blue music notes
All buttons and options now in 3D glass style
New Duet voice option — Male / Female / Duet — for songs sung by male and female voices together
Colors now match the Suno app exactly — black, white and grey everywhere
Connects automatically — no setup, no cookie, no settings: just open the app and make songs
Interface redesigned to match the Suno app's look and feel — Create, Library and Player, same-to-same
Settings screen removed — only Create, Reference and Library
